projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM instantaneous2022January/July15T00Z;not monthly means or seasonal envelopes.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial outer/slope East Greenland78.5N Fram Strait to59N study-boundary corridor. Distinct coastal EGCC, upstream Arctic extensions, interior branches and onward West Greenland are excluded as target identities. South of64N EGC/Irminger merging and return-Atlantic/deep same-sign flow can contaminate a geographic component proxy. No water-mass partition, coastal/slope separation or independently identified isobath/axis is performed. Source1000m shelf boundary,upper200m freshwater integral and mooring depth limits are not current bottoms.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Keep every original fixed-longitude section in declared downstream order. Use selected native model positions;where no column qualifies,use actualnativewrappedlongitude and the declaredlatitude-gate midpoint only as an explicit unresolved reference geometry placeholder with no sampled position or depth. ShortestWGS84legs connect adjacentoriginal references,including across180/-180. Assume linear lowerdepth and paired modelspan only between neighboring original supported nodes;never skip,extrapolate or fill from an alternate cutoff. Distances are reference geometry,not measured current lengths.

projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section surface-connected integral maximum and resolved declared primary lower contour;selected model columns do not independently validate named-current axes.
projections.branch_scope: Partial northward shelf-break West Greenland59.4–67N editorial Cape Farewell-approach to Davis-Strait gate. Exclude inshore WGCC, westward bifurcation into Labrador Sea, detached Irminger Rings, fjords, upstream EGC/Irminger and onward Baffin continuation as target identities. Surface Arctic and deeper Atlantic waters may share sign; velocity-connected span does not partition water masses. Source top50m averaging and500m pathway isobath are not whole-current thickness. Broad maxima can be coastal or other-branch flow; no independent branch/axis identity is claimed.
